transcript.question: Welcome to Antara. Do you understand that this conversation is strictly confidential, encrypted, and that a clinical report and transcript will be provided only to your therapist before your session, after which your data is erased?
How are you feeling right now as you sit down for this conversation?
transcript.finalAnswer: A bit guarded. Not really used to talking about my feelings.

transcript.question: If you check in with your body right now, is there any physical sensation or tightness you notice?
Are there times in your day or specific situations where keeping your guard up feels hardest?
transcript.finalAnswer: When college group projects get chaotic and people expect me to take charge of everything.

transcript.question: How has your daily routine been feeling—sleep, food, physical energy?
transcript.finalAnswer: My sleep is okay, maybe 6 hours. Appetite is normal. I just feel mentally foggy by 2 PM.

transcript.question: How do you feel when interacting with family or close friends?
What made you decide to schedule this therapy session?
transcript.finalAnswer: I realized I bottle everything up until I feel completely shut down. I want to learn to talk about hard things before I freeze up.
